{'content': 'Alongside the all-new Mac mini, Apple today announced the next-generation Mac Studio. The new Mac Studio lineup features the M5 Max and M5 Ultra chips, with support for up to 512GB of unified memory.', 'index': 0}

{'content': 'Orders for the new Mac Studio models begin today.', 'index': 1}

{'content': 'M5 Max Mac Studio', 'index': 2}

{'content': 'Apple first unveiled the new Mac Studio powered by the M5 Max, an upgrade over the previous-generation M4 Max model. The M5 Max first debuted earlier this year in the MacBook Pro.', 'index': 3}

{'content': 'The M5 Max features an 18-core CPU, including 6 super cores and 12 performance cores. The GPU can be configured with up to 40 cores, with each core featuring a built-in neural accelerator. Apple says GPU performance is up to 50% faster than the previous generation. Unified memory bandwidth is up to 614GB/s, up from a maximum of 546GB/s on the M4 Max generation.', 'index': 4}

{'content': 'The M5 Max Mac Studio starts with 36GB of unified memory and supports up to 128GB. For comparison, those are the same specs that the M4 Max Mac Studio launched with originally. However, over the past year, Apple has gradually cut configuration options amid industry-wide memory shortages. As of yesterday, the M4 Max Mac Studio started with 36GB of memory and topped out at 96GB.', 'index': 5}

{'content': 'Here are some benchmark figures that Apple provided for the M5 Max Mac Studio:', 'index': 6}

  • {'content': 'Large language model prompt processing in LM Studio is up to 10.7x faster than the Mac Studio with M1 Max, and up to 3.9x faster than M4 Max.', 'index': 7}
  • {'content': 'Text-to-image performance is up to 7.4x faster than the Mac Studio with M1 Max, and up to 3.5x faster than M4 Max.', 'index': 8}
  • {'content': 'Magic Mask performance in Blackmagic Design DaVinci Resolve Studio is up to 5.3x faster than the Mac Studio with M1 Max, and up to 3x faster than M4 Max.', 'index': 9}
  • {'content': 'DNA sequencing basecalling in Oxford Nanopore MinKNOW is up to 3.5x faster than the Mac Studio with M1 Max, and up to 1.9x faster than M4 Max.', 'index': 10}

{'content': 'M5 Ultra Mac Studio', 'index': 11}

{'content': "The real star of today's announcements is the M5 Ultra Mac Studio.", 'index': 12}

{'content': 'The new M5 Ultra Mac Studio offers up to a 36-core CPU, including 12 super cores and 24 performance cores. Multi-threaded performance is up to 1.3x faster than the previous-generation M3 Ultra Mac Studio.', 'index': 13}

{'content': 'The M5 Ultra features an up to 80-core GPU, which Apple says is the most powerful GPU ever in an Apple silicon chip. This is also the first time Apple has added neural accelerators to an Ultra chip. Neural accelerators are dedicated hardware in each GPU core designed to accelerate AI workloads.', 'index': 14}

{'content': "For memory, the Mac Studio with M5 Ultra starts at 96GB and can be configured with up to 512GB. This is the same as when the M3 Ultra Mac Studio originally launched. However, over the past year, Apple cut the M3 Ultra Mac Studio's memory options down to just 96GB amid memory shortages. Memory bandwidth is up to 1.2TB/s.", 'index': 15}

{'content': "The M5 Ultra's media engine features 2x the number of video encode and decode blocks compared to the M5 Max, with support for up to 33 streams of simultaneous 8K ProRes video playback.", 'index': 16}

{'content': 'Apple provided the following benchmark figures for the M5 Ultra Mac Studio:', 'index': 17}

  • {'content': 'CopyCat ML training in Foundry Nuke is up to 15.4x faster than the Mac Studio with M1 Ultra, and up to 3.3x faster than M3 Ultra.', 'index': 18}
  • {'content': 'Large language model prompt processing in LM Studio is up to 9.8x faster than the Mac Studio with M1 Ultra, and up to 4x faster than M3 Ultra.', 'index': 19}
  • {'content': 'Text-to-image performance is up to 8.2x faster than the Mac Studio with M1 Ultra, and up to 4.3x faster than M3 Ultra.', 'index': 20}
  • {'content': 'Scene rendering in Maxon Redshift is up to 4.7x faster than the Mac Studio with M1 Ultra, and up to 1.7x faster than M3 Ultra.', 'index': 21}

{'content': 'More Mac Studio specs and details', 'index': 22}

  • {'content': 'Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 support, powered by the Apple N1 networking chip', 'index': 23}
  • {'content': 'Support for up to eight external displays, or up to four Studio Display XDR with 5K resolution and 120Hz refresh rate', 'index': 24}
  • {'content': 'Storage performance up to 2x faster with PCIe Gen 6 support', 'index': 25}
  • {'content': 'Thunderbolt 5 with up to 120Gb/s bandwidth', 'index': 26}
  • {'content': 'Genlock support over USB-C for precise synchronization between displays and professional cameras', 'index': 27}

{'content': 'Mac Studio pricing and availability', 'index': 28}

{'content': 'The Mac Studio with M5 Max starts at $2,499 with 512GB of base storage, the same price as the M4 Max Mac Studio. The Mac Studio with M5 Ultra starts at $5,499 with 1TB of storage, a $200 increase over the M3 Ultra version.', 'index': 29}

{'content': 'Buy Mac Studio from Apple:', 'index': 30}

  • {'content': 'M5 Max Mac Studio: $2,499 starting (or $2,299 with education pricing)', 'index': 31}
  • {'content': 'M5 Ultra Mac Studio: $5,499 starting (or $5,099 with education pricing)', 'index': 32}

{'content': 'The new Mac Studio lineup is available to order starting today, and will begin arriving to customers on September 22. However, Apple says the Mac Studio with M5 Ultra and 512GB of memory will be "available in late October."', 'index': 33}
